_doc: The S4 frame witness for the Smooth tool (transform-correct path verbs). The 16-segment zigzag of smooth_zigzag sits inside a group with the NON-UNIFORM matrix (2,0,0,3,225,150) in pt, so it is DRAWN from x 225 to 465. The press at (285,231) is the drawn image of local (30,27). Every local point is more than the 100-unit radius away from it, so the old pass, which compared local points, changed nothing. Now the radius and the fit error are document-space tolerances: only the commands drawn within 100 of the cursor are refitted, in document space, and the fitted control points are mapped back into the path's local space. The golden is generated by the Rust port and must agree with the Swift port; the law is pinned by the oracle unit test the_smooth_tool_fits_in_document_space.
name: smooth_zigzag_in_scaled_group
